content.latin: Veníte, exsultémus Dómino, iubilémus Deo, salutári nostro: præoccupémus fáciem eius in confessióne, et in psalmis iubilémus ei.
content.english: Come let us praise the Lord with joy: let us joyfully sing to God our saviour. Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving; and make a joyful noise to him with psalms.

content.latin: Quóniam Deus magnus Dóminus, et Rex magnus super omnes deos, quóniam non repéllet Dóminus plebem suam: quia in manu eius sunt omnes fines terræ, et altitúdines móntium ipse cónspicit.
content.english: For the Lord is a great God, and a great King above all gods. For the Lord will not cast off his people: for in his hand are all the ends of the earth, and the heights of the mountains are his.

content.latin: Ant. Veníte, adorémus.
content.english: Ant. O come, let us worship Him.

segments.t: Ant.
Veníte, adorémus.

content.latin: Quóniam ipsíus est mare, et ipse fecit illud, et áridam fundavérunt manus eius (genuflectitur) veníte, adorémus, et procidámus ante Deum: plorémus coram Dómino, qui fecit nos, quia ipse est Dóminus, Deus noster; nos autem pópulus eius, et oves páscuæ eius.
content.english: For the sea is his, and he made it: and his hands formed the dry land. (genuflect) Come let us adore and fall down: and weep before the Lord that made us: For he is the Lord our God: and we are the people of his pasture and the sheep of his hand.

segments.t: Quóniam ipsíus est mare, et ipse fecit illud, et áridam fundavérunt manus eius

content.latin: Hódie, si vocem eius audiéritis, nolíte obduráre corda vestra, sicut in exacerbatióne secúndum diem tentatiónis in desérto: ubi tentavérunt me patres vestri, probavérunt et vidérunt ópera mea.
content.english: Today if you shall hear his voice, harden not your hearts: As in the provocation, according to the day of temptation in the wilderness: where your fathers tempted me, they proved me, and saw my works.

content.latin: Ant. Veníte, adorémus.

content.latin: Quadragínta annis próximus fui generatióni huic, et dixi: Semper hi errant corde, ipsi vero non cognovérunt vias meas: quibus iurávi in ira mea: Si introíbunt in réquiem meam.
content.english: Forty years long was I offended with that generation, and I said: These always err in heart. And these men have not known my ways: so I swore in my wrath that they shall not enter into my rest.

content.latin: Custódes hóminum psállimus Angelos,
content.english: Angel-guardians of men, spirits and powers we sing,

content.latin: Natúræ frágili quos Pater áddidit
content.english: Whom our Father hath sent, aids to our weakly frame,

content.latin: Cæléstis cómites, insidiántibus
content.english: Heavenly friends and guides, help from on high to bring,

content.latin: Ne succúmberet hóstibus.
content.english: Lest we fail through the foeman's wile.

content.latin: Nam, quod corrúerit próditor ángelus,
content.english: He, the spoiler of souls, angel-traitor of old,

content.latin: Concéssis mérito pulsus honóribus,
content.english: Cast in merited wrath out of his honoured place,

content.latin: Ardens invídia péllere nítitur
content.english: Burns with envy and hate, seeking their souls to gain

content.latin: Quos cælo Deus ádvocat.
content.english: Whom God's mercy invites to heaven.

content.latin: Huc, custos, ígitur pérvigil ádvola,
content.english: Therefore come to our help, watchful ward of our lives:

content.latin: Avértens pátria de tibi crédita
content.english: Turn aside from the land God to thy care confides

content.latin: Tam morbos ánimi quam requiéscere
content.english: Sickness and woe of soul, yea, and what else of ill

content.latin: Quidquid non sinit íncolas.
content.english: Peace of heart to its folk denies.

content.latin: Sanctæ sit Tríadi laus pia iúgiter,
content.english: Now to the Holy Three praise evermore resound:

content.latin: Cuius perpétuo númine máchina
content.english: Under whose hand divine resteth the triple world

content.latin: Triplex hæc régitur, cuius in ómnia
content.english: Governed in wondrous wise: glory be theirs and might

content.latin: Regnat glória sǽcula.
content.english: While the ages unending run.

content.english: Amen.

content.latin: Psalmus 8 [1]
content.english: Psalm 8 [1]

segments.t: Psalmus 8

content.latin: 8:2 Dómine, Dóminus noster, * quam admirábile est nomen tuum in univérsa terra!
content.english: 8:2 O Lord our Lord, * how admirable is thy name in the whole earth!

segments.t: Dómine, Dóminus noster, * quam admirábile est nomen tuum in univérsa terra!

content.latin: 8:2 Quóniam eleváta est magnificéntia tua, * super cælos.
content.english: 8:2 For thy magnificence is elevated * above the heavens.

segments.t: Quóniam eleváta est magnificéntia tua, * super cælos.

content.latin: 8:3 Ex ore infántium et lacténtium perfecísti laudem propter inimícos tuos, * ut déstruas inimícum et ultórem.
content.english: 8:3 Out of the mouth of infants and of sucklings thou hast perfected praise, because of thy enemies, * that thou mayst destroy the enemy and the avenger.

segments.t: Ex ore infántium et lacténtium perfecísti laudem propter inimícos tuos, * ut déstruas inimícum et ultórem.

content.latin: 8:4 Quóniam vidébo cælos tuos, ópera digitórum tuórum: * lunam et stellas, quæ tu fundásti.
content.english: 8:4 For I will behold thy heavens, the works of thy fingers: * the moon and the stars which thou hast founded.

segments.t: Quóniam vidébo cælos tuos, ópera digitórum tuórum: * lunam et stellas, quæ tu fundásti.

content.latin: 8:5 Quid est homo quod memor es eius? * aut fílius hóminis, quóniam vísitas eum?
content.english: 8:5 What is man that thou art mindful of him? * or the son of man that thou visitest him?

segments.t: Quid est homo quod memor es eius? * aut fílius hóminis, quóniam vísitas eum?

content.latin: 8:6 Minuísti eum paulo minus ab Ángelis, glória et honóre coronásti eum: * et constituísti eum super ópera mánuum tuárum.
content.english: 8:6 Thou hast made him a little less than the angels, thou hast crowned him with glory and honour: * and hast set him over the works of thy hands.

segments.t: Minuísti eum paulo minus ab Ángelis, glória et honóre coronásti eum: * et constituísti eum super ópera mánuum tuárum.

content.latin: 8:8 Ómnia subiecísti sub pédibus eius, * oves et boves univérsas: ínsuper et pécora campi.
content.english: 8:8 Thou hast subjected all things under his feet, * all sheep and oxen: moreover the beasts also of the fields.

segments.t: Ómnia subiecísti sub pédibus eius, * oves et boves univérsas: ínsuper et pécora campi.

content.latin: 8:9 Vólucres cæli, et pisces maris, * qui perámbulant sémitas maris.
content.english: 8:9 The birds of the air, and the fishes of the sea, * that pass through the paths of the sea.

segments.t: Vólucres cæli, et pisces maris, * qui perámbulant sémitas maris.

content.english: 8:10 O Lord our Lord, * how admirable is thy name in all the earth!

segments.t: Dómine, Dóminus noster, * quam admirábile est nomen tuum in univérsa terra!

content.latin: Psalmus 10 [2]
content.english: Psalm 10 [2]

segments.t: Psalmus 10

content.latin: 10:2 In Dómino confído: quómodo dícitis ánimæ meæ: * Tránsmigra in montem sicut passer?
content.english: 10:2 In the Lord I put my trust: how then do you say to my soul: * Get thee away from hence to the mountain, like a sparrow?

segments.t: In Dómino confído: quómodo dícitis ánimæ meæ: * Tránsmigra in montem sicut passer?

content.latin: 10:3 Quóniam ecce peccatóres intendérunt arcum, paravérunt sagíttas suas in pháretra, * ut sagíttent in obscúro rectos corde.
content.english: 10:3 For, lo, the wicked have bent their bow: they have prepared their arrows in the quiver, * to shoot in the dark the upright of heart.

segments.t: Quóniam ecce peccatóres intendérunt arcum, paravérunt sagíttas suas in pháretra, * ut sagíttent in obscúro rectos corde.

content.latin: 10:4 Quóniam quæ perfecísti, destruxérunt: * iustus autem quid fecit?
content.english: 10:4 For they have destroyed the things which thou hast made: * but what has the just man done?

segments.t: Quóniam quæ perfecísti, destruxérunt: * iustus autem quid fecit?

content.latin: 10:5 Dóminus in templo sancto suo, * Dóminus in cælo sedes eius.
content.english: 10:5 The Lord is in his holy temple, * the Lord’s throne is in heaven.

segments.t: Dóminus in templo sancto suo, * Dóminus in cælo sedes eius.

content.latin: 10:5 Óculi eius in páuperem respíciunt: * pálpebræ eius intérrogant fílios hóminum.
content.english: 10:5 His eyes look on the poor man: * his eyelids examine the sons of men.

segments.t: Óculi eius in páuperem respíciunt: * pálpebræ eius intérrogant fílios hóminum.

content.latin: 10:6 Dóminus intérrogat iustum et ímpium: * qui autem díligit iniquitátem, odit ánimam suam.
content.english: 10:6 The Lord trieth the just and the wicked: * but he that loveth iniquity, hateth his own soul.

segments.t: Dóminus intérrogat iustum et ímpium: * qui autem díligit iniquitátem, odit ánimam suam.

content.latin: 10:7 Pluet super peccatóres láqueos: * ignis, et sulphur, et spíritus procellárum pars cálicis eórum.
content.english: 10:7 He shall rain snares upon sinners: * fire and brimstone, and storms of winds, shall be the portion of their cup.

segments.t: Pluet super peccatóres láqueos: * ignis, et sulphur, et spíritus procellárum pars cálicis eórum.

content.latin: 10:8 Quóniam iustus Dóminus, et iustítias diléxit: * æquitátem vidit vultus eius.
content.english: 10:8 For the Lord is just, and hath loved justice: * his countenance hath beheld righteousness.

segments.t: Quóniam iustus Dóminus, et iustítias diléxit: * æquitátem vidit vultus eius.

content.english: Psalm 14 [3]

segments.t: Psalmus 14

content.latin: 14:1 Dómine, quis habitábit in tabernáculo tuo? * aut quis requiéscet in monte sancto tuo?
content.english: 14:1 Lord, who shall dwell in thy tabernacle? * or who shall rest in thy holy hill?

segments.t: Dómine, quis habitábit in tabernáculo tuo? * aut quis requiéscet in monte sancto tuo?

content.latin: 14:2 Qui ingréditur sine mácula, * et operátur iustítiam:
content.english: 14:2 He that walketh without blemish, * and worketh justice:

segments.t: Qui ingréditur sine mácula, * et operátur iustítiam:

content.latin: 14:3 Qui lóquitur veritátem in corde suo, * qui non egit dolum in lingua sua:
content.english: 14:3 He that speaketh truth in his heart, * who hath not used deceit in his tongue:

segments.t: Qui lóquitur veritátem in corde suo, * qui non egit dolum in lingua sua:

content.latin: 14:3 Nec fecit próximo suo malum, * et oppróbrium non accépit advérsus próximos suos.
content.english: 14:3 Nor hath done evil to his neighbour: * nor taken up a reproach against his neighbours.

segments.t: Nec fecit próximo suo malum, * et oppróbrium non accépit advérsus próximos suos.

content.latin: 14:4 Ad níhilum dedúctus est in conspéctu eius malígnus: * timéntes autem Dóminum gloríficat:
content.english: 14:4 In his sight the malignant is brought to nothing: * but he glorifieth them that fear the Lord:

segments.t: Ad níhilum dedúctus est in conspéctu eius malígnus: * timéntes autem Dóminum gloríficat:

content.latin: 14:4 Qui iurat próximo suo, et non décipit, * qui pecúniam suam non dedit ad usúram, et múnera super innocéntem non accépit.
content.english: 14:4 He that sweareth to his neighbour, and deceiveth not; * He that hath not put out his money to usury, nor taken bribes against the innocent:

segments.t: Qui iurat próximo suo, et non décipit, * qui pecúniam suam non dedit ad usúram, et múnera super innocéntem non accépit.

content.latin: 14:5 Qui facit hæc: * non movébitur in ætérnum.
content.english: 14:5 He that doth these things, * shall not be moved for ever.

segments.t: Qui facit hæc: * non movébitur in ætérnum.

content.latin: Psalmus 18 [4]
content.english: Psalm 18 [4]

segments.t: Psalmus 18

content.latin: 18:2 Cæli enárrant glóriam Dei: * et ópera mánuum eius annúntiat firmaméntum.
content.english: 18:2 The heavens shew forth the glory of God, * and the firmament declareth the work of his hands.

segments.t: Cæli enárrant glóriam Dei: * et ópera mánuum eius annúntiat firmaméntum.

content.latin: 18:3 Dies diéi erúctat verbum, * et nox nocti índicat sciéntiam.
content.english: 18:3 Day to day uttereth speech, * and night to night sheweth knowledge.

segments.t: Dies diéi erúctat verbum, * et nox nocti índicat sciéntiam.

content.latin: 18:4 Non sunt loquélæ, neque sermónes, * quorum non audiántur voces eórum.
content.english: 18:4 There are no speeches nor languages, * where their voices are not heard.

segments.t: Non sunt loquélæ, neque sermónes, * quorum non audiántur voces eórum.

content.latin: 18:5 In omnem terram exívit sonus eórum: * et in fines orbis terræ verba eórum.
content.english: 18:5 Their sound hath gone forth into all the earth: * and their words unto the ends of the world.

segments.t: In omnem terram exívit sonus eórum: * et in fines orbis terræ verba eórum.

content.latin: 18:6 In sole pósuit tabernáculum suum: * et ipse tamquam sponsus procédens de thálamo suo:
content.english: 18:6 He hath set his tabernacle in the sun: * and he, as a bridegroom coming out of his bride chamber,

segments.t: In sole pósuit tabernáculum suum: * et ipse tamquam sponsus procédens de thálamo suo:

content.latin: 18:6 Exsultávit ut gigas ad curréndam viam, * a summo cælo egréssio eius:
content.english: 18:6 Hath rejoiced as a giant to run the way: * his going out is from the end of heaven,

segments.t: Exsultávit ut gigas ad curréndam viam, * a summo cælo egréssio eius:

content.latin: 18:7 Et occúrsus eius usque ad summum eius: * nec est qui se abscóndat a calóre eius.
content.english: 18:7 And his circuit even to the end thereof: * and there is no one that can hide himself from his heat.

segments.t: Et occúrsus eius usque ad summum eius: * nec est qui se abscóndat a calóre eius.

content.latin: 18:8 Lex Dómini immaculáta, convértens ánimas: * testimónium Dómini fidéle, sapiéntiam præstans párvulis.
content.english: 18:8 The law of the Lord is unspotted, converting souls: * the testimony of the Lord is faithful, giving wisdom to little ones.

segments.t: Lex Dómini immaculáta, convértens ánimas: * testimónium Dómini fidéle, sapiéntiam præstans párvulis.

content.latin: 18:9 Iustítiæ Dómini rectæ, lætificántes corda: * præcéptum Dómini lúcidum, illúminans óculos.
content.english: 18:9 The justices of the Lord are right, rejoicing hearts: * the commandment of the Lord is lightsome, enlightening the eyes.

segments.t: Iustítiæ Dómini rectæ, lætificántes corda: * præcéptum Dómini lúcidum, illúminans óculos.

content.latin: 18:10 Timor Dómini sanctus, pérmanens in sǽculum sǽculi: * iudícia Dómini vera, iustificáta in semetípsa.
content.english: 18:10 The fear of the Lord is holy, enduring for ever and ever: * the judgments of the Lord are true, justified in themselves.

segments.t: Timor Dómini sanctus, pérmanens in sǽculum sǽculi: * iudícia Dómini vera, iustificáta in semetípsa.

content.latin: 18:11 Desiderabília super aurum et lápidem pretiósum multum: * et dulcióra super mel et favum.
content.english: 18:11 More to be desired than gold and many precious stones: * and sweeter than honey and the honeycomb.

segments.t: Desiderabília super aurum et lápidem pretiósum multum: * et dulcióra super mel et favum.

content.latin: 18:12 Étenim servus tuus custódit ea, * in custodiéndis illis retribútio multa.
content.english: 18:12 For thy servant keepeth them, * and in keeping them there is a great reward.

segments.t: Étenim servus tuus custódit ea, * in custodiéndis illis retribútio multa.

content.latin: 18:13 Delícta quis intéllegit? ab occúltis meis munda me: * et ab aliénis parce servo tuo.
content.english: 18:13 Who can understand sins? from my secret ones cleanse me, O Lord: * and from those of others spare thy servant.

segments.t: Delícta quis intéllegit? ab occúltis meis munda me: * et ab aliénis parce servo tuo.

content.latin: 18:14 Si mei non fúerint domináti, tunc immaculátus ero: * et emundábor a delícto máximo.
content.english: 18:14 If they shall have no dominion over me, then shall I be without spot: * and I shall be cleansed from the greatest sin.

segments.t: Si mei non fúerint domináti, tunc immaculátus ero: * et emundábor a delícto máximo.

content.latin: 18:15 Et erunt ut compláceant elóquia oris mei: * et meditátio cordis mei in conspéctu tuo semper.
content.english: 18:15 And the words of my mouth shall be such as may please: * and the meditation of my heart always in thy sight.

segments.t: Et erunt ut compláceant elóquia oris mei: * et meditátio cordis mei in conspéctu tuo semper.

content.latin: 18:15 Dómine, adiútor meus, * et redémptor meus.
content.english: 18:15 O Lord, my helper, * and my redeemer.

segments.t: Dómine, adiútor meus, * et redémptor meus.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Cum essem vobíscum, per voluntátem Dei eram: ipsum benedícite et cantáte ei.
content.english: Ant. When I came unto you, by the will of God I came; bless Him, and give Him thanks.

segments.t: Ant.
Cum essem vobíscum, per voluntátem Dei eram: ipsum benedícite et cantáte ei.

content.english: Ant. The Angel of the Lord, which went before the camp of Israel, removed, and went behind them.

Tollens se Angelus Dómini, * qui præcedébat castra Israël, ábiit post eos.

content.latin: Psalmus 23 [5]
content.english: Psalm 23 [5]

segments.t: Psalmus 23

content.latin: 23:1 Dómini est terra, et plenitúdo eius: * orbis terrárum, et univérsi qui hábitant in eo.
content.english: 23:1 The earth is the Lord’s and the fulness thereof: * the world, and all they that dwell therein.

segments.t: Dómini est terra, et plenitúdo eius: * orbis terrárum, et univérsi qui hábitant in eo.

content.latin: 23:2 Quia ipse super mária fundávit eum: * et super flúmina præparávit eum.
content.english: 23:2 For he hath founded it upon the seas; * and hath prepared it upon the rivers.

segments.t: Quia ipse super mária fundávit eum: * et super flúmina præparávit eum.

content.latin: 23:3 Quis ascéndet in montem Dómini? * aut quis stabit in loco sancto eius?
content.english: 23:3 Who shall ascend into the mountain of the Lord: * or who shall stand in his holy place?

segments.t: Quis ascéndet in montem Dómini? * aut quis stabit in loco sancto eius?

content.latin: 23:4 Ínnocens mánibus et mundo corde, * qui non accépit in vano ánimam suam, nec iurávit in dolo próximo suo.
content.english: 23:4 The innocent in hands, and clean of heart, * who hath not taken his soul in vain, nor sworn deceitfully to his neighbour.

segments.t: Ínnocens mánibus et mundo corde, * qui non accépit in vano ánimam suam, nec iurávit in dolo próximo suo.

content.latin: 23:5 Hic accípiet benedictiónem a Dómino: * et misericórdiam a Deo, salutári suo.
content.english: 23:5 He shall receive a blessing from the Lord, * and mercy from God his Saviour.

segments.t: Hic accípiet benedictiónem a Dómino: * et misericórdiam a Deo, salutári suo.

content.latin: 23:6 Hæc est generátio quæréntium eum, * quæréntium fáciem Dei Iacob.
content.english: 23:6 This is the generation of them that seek him, * of them that seek the face of the God of Jacob.

segments.t: Hæc est generátio quæréntium eum, * quæréntium fáciem Dei Iacob.

content.latin: 23:7 Attóllite portas, príncipes, vestras, et elevámini, portæ æternáles: * et introíbit Rex glóriæ.
content.english: 23:7 Lift up your gates, O ye princes, and be ye lifted up, O eternal gates: * and the King of Glory shall enter in.

segments.t: Attóllite portas, príncipes, vestras, et elevámini, portæ æternáles: * et introíbit Rex glóriæ.

content.latin: 23:8 Quis est iste Rex glóriæ? * Dóminus fortis et potens: Dóminus potens in prǽlio.
content.english: 23:8 Who is this King of Glory? * the Lord who is strong and mighty: the Lord mighty in battle.

segments.t: Quis est iste Rex glóriæ? * Dóminus fortis et potens: Dóminus potens in prǽlio.

content.latin: 23:9 Attóllite portas, príncipes, vestras, et elevámini, portæ æternáles: * et introíbit Rex glóriæ.
content.english: 23:9 Lift up your gates, O ye princes, and be ye lifted up, O eternal gates: * and the King of Glory shall enter in.

segments.t: Attóllite portas, príncipes, vestras, et elevámini, portæ æternáles: * et introíbit Rex glóriæ.

content.latin: 23:10 Quis est iste Rex glóriæ? * Dóminus virtútum ipse est Rex glóriæ.
content.english: 23:10 Who is this King of Glory? * the Lord of hosts, he is the King of Glory.

segments.t: Quis est iste Rex glóriæ? * Dóminus virtútum ipse est Rex glóriæ.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.english: Ant. The Angel of the Lord, which went before the camp of Israel, removed, and went behind them.

segments.t: Ant.
Tollens se Angelus Dómini, qui præcedébat castra Israël, ábiit post eos.

content.latin: Ant. Immíttet Angelus Dómini * in circúitu timéntium eum, et erípiet eos.
content.english: Ant. The Angel of the Lord encampeth round about them that fear Him, and delivereth them.

segments.t: Ant.
Immíttet Angelus Dómini * in circúitu timéntium eum, et erípiet eos.

content.latin: Psalmus 33 [6]
content.english: Psalm 33 [6]

segments.t: Psalmus 33

content.latin: 33:2 Benedícam Dóminum in omni témpore: * semper laus eius in ore meo.
content.english: 33:2 I will bless the Lord at all times, * his praise shall be always in my mouth.

segments.t: Benedícam Dóminum in omni témpore: * semper laus eius in ore meo.

content.latin: 33:3 In Dómino laudábitur ánima mea: * áudiant mansuéti, et læténtur.
content.english: 33:3 In the Lord shall my soul be praised: * let the meek hear and rejoice.

segments.t: In Dómino laudábitur ánima mea: * áudiant mansuéti, et læténtur.

content.latin: 33:4 Magnificáte Dóminum mecum: * et exaltémus nomen eius in idípsum.
content.english: 33:4 O magnify the Lord with me; * and let us extol his name together.

segments.t: Magnificáte Dóminum mecum: * et exaltémus nomen eius in idípsum.

content.latin: 33:5 Exquisívi Dóminum, et exaudívit me: * et ex ómnibus tribulatiónibus meis erípuit me.
content.english: 33:5 I sought the Lord, and he heard me; * and he delivered me from all my troubles.

segments.t: Exquisívi Dóminum, et exaudívit me: * et ex ómnibus tribulatiónibus meis erípuit me.

content.latin: 33:6 Accédite ad eum, et illuminámini: * et fácies vestræ non confundéntur.
content.english: 33:6 Come ye to him and be enlightened: * and your faces shall not be confounded.

segments.t: Accédite ad eum, et illuminámini: * et fácies vestræ non confundéntur.

content.latin: 33:7 Iste pauper clamávit, et Dóminus exaudívit eum: * et de ómnibus tribulatiónibus eius salvávit eum.
content.english: 33:7 This poor man cried, and the Lord heard him: * and saved him out of all his troubles.

segments.t: Iste pauper clamávit, et Dóminus exaudívit eum: * et de ómnibus tribulatiónibus eius salvávit eum.

content.latin: 33:8 Immíttet Ángelus Dómini in circúitu timéntium eum: * et erípiet eos.
content.english: 33:8 The Angel of the Lord shall encamp round about them that fear him: * and shall deliver them.

segments.t: Immíttet Ángelus Dómini in circúitu timéntium eum: * et erípiet eos.

content.latin: 33:9 Gustáte, et vidéte quóniam suávis est Dóminus: * beátus vir, qui sperat in eo.
content.english: 33:9 O taste, and see that the Lord is sweet: * blessed is the man that hopeth in him.

segments.t: Gustáte, et vidéte quóniam suávis est Dóminus: * beátus vir, qui sperat in eo.

content.latin: 33:10 Timéte Dóminum, omnes sancti eius: * quóniam non est inópia timéntibus eum.
content.english: 33:10 Fear the Lord, all ye his saints: * for there is no want to them that fear him.

segments.t: Timéte Dóminum, omnes sancti eius: * quóniam non est inópia timéntibus eum.

content.latin: 33:11 Dívites eguérunt et esuriérunt: * inquiréntes autem Dóminum non minuéntur omni bono.
content.english: 33:11 The rich have wanted, and have suffered hunger: * but they that seek the Lord shall not be deprived of any good.

segments.t: Dívites eguérunt et esuriérunt: * inquiréntes autem Dóminum non minuéntur omni bono.

content.latin: 33:12 Veníte, fílii, audíte me: * timórem Dómini docébo vos.
content.english: 33:12 Come, children, hearken to me: * I will teach you the fear of the Lord.

segments.t: Veníte, fílii, audíte me: * timórem Dómini docébo vos.

content.latin: 33:13 Quis est homo qui vult vitam: * díligit dies vidére bonos?
content.english: 33:13 Who is the man that desireth life: * who loveth to see good days?

segments.t: Quis est homo qui vult vitam: * díligit dies vidére bonos?

content.latin: 33:14 Próhibe linguam tuam a malo: * et lábia tua ne loquántur dolum.
content.english: 33:14 Keep thy tongue from evil, * and thy lips from speaking guile.

segments.t: Próhibe linguam tuam a malo: * et lábia tua ne loquántur dolum.

content.latin: 33:15 Divérte a malo, et fac bonum: * inquíre pacem, et perséquere eam.
content.english: 33:15 Turn away from evil and do good: * seek after peace and pursue it.

segments.t: Divérte a malo, et fac bonum: * inquíre pacem, et perséquere eam.

content.latin: 33:16 Óculi Dómini super iustos: * et aures eius in preces eórum.
content.english: 33:16 The eyes of the Lord are upon the just: * and his ears unto their prayers.

segments.t: Óculi Dómini super iustos: * et aures eius in preces eórum.

content.latin: 33:17 Vultus autem Dómini super faciéntes mala: * ut perdat de terra memóriam eórum.
content.english: 33:17 But the countenance of the Lord is against them that do evil things: * to cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.

segments.t: Vultus autem Dómini super faciéntes mala: * ut perdat de terra memóriam eórum.

content.latin: 33:18 Clamavérunt iusti, et Dóminus exaudívit eos: * et ex ómnibus tribulatiónibus eórum liberávit eos.
content.english: 33:18 The just cried, and the Lord heard them: * and delivered them out of all their troubles.

segments.t: Clamavérunt iusti, et Dóminus exaudívit eos: * et ex ómnibus tribulatiónibus eórum liberávit eos.

content.latin: 33:19 Iuxta est Dóminus iis, qui tribuláto sunt corde: * et húmiles spíritu salvábit.
content.english: 33:19 The Lord is nigh unto them that are of a contrite heart: * and he will save the humble of spirit.

segments.t: Iuxta est Dóminus iis, qui tribuláto sunt corde: * et húmiles spíritu salvábit.

content.latin: 33:20 Multæ tribulatiónes iustórum: * et de ómnibus his liberábit eos Dóminus.
content.english: 33:20 Many are the afflictions of the just; * but out of them all will the Lord deliver them.

segments.t: Multæ tribulatiónes iustórum: * et de ómnibus his liberábit eos Dóminus.

content.latin: 33:21 Custódit Dóminus ómnia ossa eórum: * unum ex his non conterétur.
content.english: 33:21 The Lord keepeth all their bones, * not one of them shall be broken.

segments.t: Custódit Dóminus ómnia ossa eórum: * unum ex his non conterétur.

content.latin: 33:22 Mors peccatórum péssima: * et qui odérunt iustum, delínquent.
content.english: 33:22 The death of the wicked is very evil: * and they that hate the just shall be guilty.

segments.t: Mors peccatórum péssima: * et qui odérunt iustum, delínquent.

content.latin: 33:23 Rédimet Dóminus ánimas servórum suórum: * et non delínquent omnes qui sperant in eo.
content.english: 33:23 The Lord will redeem the souls of his servants: * and none of them that trust in him shall offend.

segments.t: Rédimet Dóminus ánimas servórum suórum: * et non delínquent omnes qui sperant in eo.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

Immíttet Angelus Dómini in circúitu timéntium eum, et erípiet eos.

content.latin: Ant. Misit Dóminus * Angelum suum, qui percússit omnem virum robústum et bellatórem, et príncipem exércitus regis Assyriórum.
content.english: Ant. The Lord sent His Angel, which cut off all the mighty of valour, and the leaders and captains in the camp of the King of Assyria.

segments.t: Ant.
Misit Dóminus * Angelum suum, qui percússit omnem virum robústum et bellatórem, et príncipem exércitus regis Assyriórum.

content.latin: Psalmus 95 [7]
content.english: Psalm 95 [7]

segments.t: Psalmus 95

content.latin: 95:1 Cantáte Dómino cánticum novum: * cantáte Dómino, omnis terra.
content.english: 95:1 Sing ye to the Lord a new canticle: * sing to the Lord, all the earth.

segments.t: Cantáte Dómino cánticum novum: * cantáte Dómino, omnis terra.

content.latin: 95:2 Cantáte Dómino, et benedícite nómini eius: * annuntiáte de die in diem salutáre eius.
content.english: 95:2 Sing ye to the Lord and bless his name: * shew forth his salvation from day to day.

segments.t: Cantáte Dómino, et benedícite nómini eius: * annuntiáte de die in diem salutáre eius.

content.latin: 95:3 Annuntiáte inter gentes glóriam eius, * in ómnibus pópulis mirabília eius.
content.english: 95:3 Declare his glory among the Gentiles: * his wonders among all people.

segments.t: Annuntiáte inter gentes glóriam eius, * in ómnibus pópulis mirabília eius.

content.latin: 95:4 Quóniam magnus Dóminus, et laudábilis nimis: * terríbilis est super omnes deos.
content.english: 95:4 For the Lord is great, and exceedingly to be praised: * he is to be feared above all gods.

segments.t: Quóniam magnus Dóminus, et laudábilis nimis: * terríbilis est super omnes deos.

content.latin: 95:5 Quóniam omnes dii géntium dæmónia: * Dóminus autem cælos fecit.
content.english: 95:5 For all the gods of the Gentiles are devils: * but the Lord made the heavens.

segments.t: Quóniam omnes dii géntium dæmónia: * Dóminus autem cælos fecit.

content.latin: 95:6 Conféssio, et pulchritúdo in conspéctu eius: * sanctimónia et magnificéntia in sanctificatióne eius.
content.english: 95:6 Praise and beauty are before him: * holiness and majesty in his sanctuary.

segments.t: Conféssio, et pulchritúdo in conspéctu eius: * sanctimónia et magnificéntia in sanctificatióne eius.

content.latin: 95:7 Afférte Dómino, pátriæ géntium, afférte Dómino glóriam et honórem: * afférte Dómino glóriam nómini eius.
content.english: 95:7 Bring ye to the Lord, O ye kindreds of the Gentiles, bring ye to the Lord glory and honour: * bring to the Lord glory unto his name.

segments.t: Afférte Dómino, pátriæ géntium, afférte Dómino glóriam et honórem: * afférte Dómino glóriam nómini eius.

content.latin: 95:8 Tóllite hóstias, et introíte in átria eius: * adoráte Dóminum in átrio sancto eius.
content.english: 95:8 Bring up sacrifices, and come into his courts: * adore ye the Lord in his holy court.

segments.t: Tóllite hóstias, et introíte in átria eius: * adoráte Dóminum in átrio sancto eius.

content.latin: 95:9 Commoveátur a fácie eius univérsa terra: * dícite in géntibus quia Dóminus regnávit.
content.english: 95:9 Let all the earth be moved at his presence. * Say ye among the Gentiles, the Lord hath reigned.

segments.t: Commoveátur a fácie eius univérsa terra: * dícite in géntibus quia Dóminus regnávit.

content.latin: 95:10 Étenim corréxit orbem terræ qui non commovébitur: * iudicábit pópulos in æquitáte.
content.english: 95:10 For he hath corrected the world, which shall not be moved: * he will judge the people with justice.

segments.t: Étenim corréxit orbem terræ qui non commovébitur: * iudicábit pópulos in æquitáte.

content.latin: 95:11 Læténtur cæli, et exsúltet terra: commoveátur mare, et plenitúdo eius: * gaudébunt campi, et ómnia quæ in eis sunt.
content.english: 95:11 Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad, let the sea be moved, and the fulness thereof: * the fields and all things that are in them shall be joyful.

segments.t: Læténtur cæli, et exsúltet terra: commoveátur mare, et plenitúdo eius: * gaudébunt campi, et ómnia quæ in eis sunt.

content.latin: 95:12 Tunc exsultábunt ómnia ligna silvárum a fácie Dómini, quia venit: * quóniam venit iudicáre terram.
content.english: 95:12 Then shall all the trees of the woods rejoice before the face of the Lord, because he cometh: * because he cometh to judge the earth.

segments.t: Tunc exsultábunt ómnia ligna silvárum a fácie Dómini, quia venit: * quóniam venit iudicáre terram.

content.latin: 95:13 Iudicábit orbem terræ in æquitáte, * et pópulos in veritáte sua.
content.english: 95:13 He shall judge the world with justice, * and the people with his truth.

segments.t: Iudicábit orbem terræ in æquitáte, * et pópulos in veritáte sua.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.english: Ant. The Lord sent His Angel, which cut off all the mighty of valour, and the leaders and captains in the camp of the King of Assyria.

segments.t: Ant.
Misit Dóminus Angelum suum, qui percússit omnem virum robústum et bellatórem, et príncipem exércitus regis Assyriórum.

content.latin: Ant. Adoráte Dóminum * omnes Angeli eius: audívit, et lætáta est Sion.
content.english: Ant. Worship the Lord, all ye His Angels! Zion heard, and was glad.

segments.t: Ant.
Adoráte Dóminum * omnes Angeli eius: audívit, et lætáta est Sion.

content.latin: Psalmus 96 [8]
content.english: Psalm 96 [8]

segments.t: Psalmus 96

content.latin: 96:1 Dóminus regnávit, exsúltet terra: * læténtur ínsulæ multæ.
content.english: 96:1 The Lord hath reigned, let the earth rejoice: * let many islands be glad.

segments.t: Dóminus regnávit, exsúltet terra: * læténtur ínsulæ multæ.

content.latin: 96:2 Nubes, et calígo in circúitu eius: * iustítia, et iudícium corréctio sedis eius.
content.english: 96:2 Clouds and darkness are round about him: * justice and judgment are the establishment of his throne.

segments.t: Nubes, et calígo in circúitu eius: * iustítia, et iudícium corréctio sedis eius.

content.latin: 96:3 Ignis ante ipsum præcédet, * et inflammábit in circúitu inimícos eius.
content.english: 96:3 A fire shall go before him, * and shall burn his enemies round about.

segments.t: Ignis ante ipsum præcédet, * et inflammábit in circúitu inimícos eius.

content.latin: 96:4 Illuxérunt fúlgura eius orbi terræ: * vidit, et commóta est terra.
content.english: 96:4 His lightnings have shone forth to the world: * the earth saw and trembled.

segments.t: Illuxérunt fúlgura eius orbi terræ: * vidit, et commóta est terra.

content.latin: 96:5 Montes, sicut cera fluxérunt a fácie Dómini: * a fácie Dómini omnis terra.
content.english: 96:5 The mountains melted like wax, at the presence of the Lord: * at the presence of the Lord of all the earth.

segments.t: Montes, sicut cera fluxérunt a fácie Dómini: * a fácie Dómini omnis terra.

content.latin: 96:6 Annuntiavérunt cæli iustítiam eius: * et vidérunt omnes pópuli glóriam eius.
content.english: 96:6 The heavens declared his justice: * and all people saw his glory.

segments.t: Annuntiavérunt cæli iustítiam eius: * et vidérunt omnes pópuli glóriam eius.

content.latin: 96:7 Confundántur omnes, qui adórant sculptília: * et qui gloriántur in simulácris suis.
content.english: 96:7 Let them be all confounded that adore graven things, * and that glory in their idols.

segments.t: Confundántur omnes, qui adórant sculptília: * et qui gloriántur in simulácris suis.

content.latin: 96:7 Adoráte eum, omnes Ángeli eius: * audívit, et lætáta est Sion.
content.english: 96:7 Adore him, all you his angels: * Sion heard, and was glad.

segments.t: Adoráte eum, omnes Ángeli eius: * audívit, et lætáta est Sion.

content.latin: 96:8 Et exsultavérunt fíliæ Iudæ, * propter iudícia tua, Dómine:
content.english: 96:8 And the daughters of Juda rejoiced, * because of thy judgments, O Lord.

segments.t: Et exsultavérunt fíliæ Iudæ, * propter iudícia tua, Dómine:

content.latin: 96:9 Quóniam tu Dóminus Altíssimus super omnem terram: * nimis exaltátus es super omnes deos.
content.english: 96:9 For thou art the most high Lord over all the earth: * thou art exalted exceedingly above all gods.

segments.t: Quóniam tu Dóminus Altíssimus super omnem terram: * nimis exaltátus es super omnes deos.

content.latin: 96:10 Qui dilígitis Dóminum, odíte malum: * custódit Dóminus ánimas sanctórum suórum, de manu peccatóris liberábit eos.
content.english: 96:10 You that love the Lord, hate evil: * the Lord preserveth the souls of his saints, he will deliver them out of the hand of the sinner.

segments.t: Qui dilígitis Dóminum, odíte malum: * custódit Dóminus ánimas sanctórum suórum, de manu peccatóris liberábit eos.

content.latin: 96:11 Lux orta est iusto, * et rectis corde lætítia.
content.english: 96:11 Light is risen to the just, * and joy to the right of heart.

segments.t: Lux orta est iusto, * et rectis corde lætítia.

content.latin: 96:12 Lætámini, iusti, in Dómino: * et confitémini memóriæ sanctificatiónis eius.
content.english: 96:12 Rejoice, ye just, in the Lord: * and give praise to the remembrance of his holiness.

segments.t: Lætámini, iusti, in Dómino: * et confitémini memóriæ sanctificatiónis eius.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Adoráte Dóminum omnes Angeli eius: audívit, et lætáta est Sion.
content.english: Ant. Worship the Lord, all ye His Angels! Zion heard, and was glad.

segments.t: Ant.
Adoráte Dóminum omnes Angeli eius: audívit, et lætáta est Sion.

content.latin: Ant. Benedícite Dómino, * omnes Angeli eius, poténtes virtúte, faciéntes verbum illíus, ad audiéndam vocem sermónum eius.
content.english: Ant. Bless the Lord, all ye His Angels, that excel in strength, that do His commandments, to hearken unto the voice of His word.

segments.t: Ant.
Benedícite Dómino, * omnes Angeli eius, poténtes virtúte, faciéntes verbum illíus, ad audiéndam vocem sermónum eius.

content.latin: Psalmus 102 [9]
content.english: Psalm 102 [9]

segments.t: Psalmus 102

content.latin: 102:1 Bénedic, ánima mea, Dómino: * et ómnia, quæ intra me sunt, nómini sancto eius.
content.english: 102:1 Bless the Lord, O my soul: * and let all that is within me bless his holy name.

segments.t: Bénedic, ánima mea, Dómino: * et ómnia, quæ intra me sunt, nómini sancto eius.

content.latin: 102:2 Bénedic, ánima mea, Dómino: * et noli oblivísci omnes retributiónes eius.
content.english: 102:2 Bless the Lord, O my soul, * and never forget all he hath done for thee.

segments.t: Bénedic, ánima mea, Dómino: * et noli oblivísci omnes retributiónes eius.

content.latin: 102:3 Qui propitiátur ómnibus iniquitátibus tuis: * qui sanat omnes infirmitátes tuas.
content.english: 102:3 Who forgiveth all thy iniquities: * who healeth all thy diseases.

segments.t: Qui propitiátur ómnibus iniquitátibus tuis: * qui sanat omnes infirmitátes tuas.

content.latin: 102:4 Qui rédimit de intéritu vitam tuam: * qui corónat te in misericórdia et miseratiónibus.
content.english: 102:4 Who redeemeth thy life from destruction: * who crowneth thee with mercy and compassion.

segments.t: Qui rédimit de intéritu vitam tuam: * qui corónat te in misericórdia et miseratiónibus.

content.latin: 102:5 Qui replet in bonis desidérium tuum: * renovábitur ut áquilæ iuvéntus tua:
content.english: 102:5 Who satisfieth thy desire with good things: * thy youth shall be renewed like the eagle’s.

segments.t: Qui replet in bonis desidérium tuum: * renovábitur ut áquilæ iuvéntus tua:

content.latin: 102:6 Fáciens misericórdias Dóminus: * et iudícium ómnibus iniúriam patiéntibus.
content.english: 102:6 The Lord doth mercies, * and judgment for all that suffer wrong.

segments.t: Fáciens misericórdias Dóminus: * et iudícium ómnibus iniúriam patiéntibus.

content.latin: 102:7 Notas fecit vias suas Móysi, * fíliis Israël voluntátes suas.
content.english: 102:7 He hath made his ways known to Moses: * his wills to the children of Israel.

segments.t: Notas fecit vias suas Móysi, * fíliis Israël voluntátes suas.

content.latin: 102:8 Miserátor, et miséricors Dóminus: * longánimis, et multum miséricors.
content.english: 102:8 The Lord is compassionate and merciful: * longsuffering and plenteous in mercy.

segments.t: Miserátor, et miséricors Dóminus: * longánimis, et multum miséricors.

content.latin: 102:9 Non in perpétuum irascétur: * neque in ætérnum comminábitur.
content.english: 102:9 He will not always be angry: * nor will he threaten for ever.

segments.t: Non in perpétuum irascétur: * neque in ætérnum comminábitur.

content.latin: 102:10 Non secúndum peccáta nostra fecit nobis: * neque secúndum iniquitátes nostras retríbuit nobis.
content.english: 102:10 He hath not dealt with us according to our sins: * nor rewarded us according to our iniquities.

segments.t: Non secúndum peccáta nostra fecit nobis: * neque secúndum iniquitátes nostras retríbuit nobis.

content.latin: 102:11 Quóniam secúndum altitúdinem cæli a terra: * corroborávit misericórdiam suam super timéntes se.
content.english: 102:11 For according to the height of the heaven above the earth: * he hath strengthened his mercy towards them that fear him.

segments.t: Quóniam secúndum altitúdinem cæli a terra: * corroborávit misericórdiam suam super timéntes se.

content.latin: 102:12 Quantum distat ortus ab occidénte: * longe fecit a nobis iniquitátes nostras.
content.english: 102:12 As far as the east is from the west, * so far hath he removed our iniquities from us.

segments.t: Quantum distat ortus ab occidénte: * longe fecit a nobis iniquitátes nostras.

content.latin: 102:13 Quómodo miserétur pater filiórum, misértus est Dóminus timéntibus se: * quóniam ipse cognóvit figméntum nostrum.
content.english: 102:13 As a father hath compassion on his children, so hath the Lord compassion on them that fear him: * for he knoweth our frame.

segments.t: Quómodo miserétur pater filiórum, misértus est Dóminus timéntibus se: * quóniam ipse cognóvit figméntum nostrum.

content.latin: 102:14 Recordátus est quóniam pulvis sumus: * homo, sicut fænum dies eius, tamquam flos agri sic efflorébit.
content.english: 102:14 He remembereth that we are dust: * man’s days are as grass, as the flower of the field so shall he flourish.

segments.t: Recordátus est quóniam pulvis sumus: * homo, sicut fænum dies eius, tamquam flos agri sic efflorébit.

content.latin: 102:16 Quóniam spíritus pertransíbit in illo, et non subsístet: * et non cognóscet ámplius locum suum.
content.english: 102:16 For the spirit shall pass in him, and he shall not be: * and he shall know his place no more.

segments.t: Quóniam spíritus pertransíbit in illo, et non subsístet: * et non cognóscet ámplius locum suum.

content.latin: 102:17 Misericórdia autem Dómini ab ætérno, * et usque in ætérnum super timéntes eum.
content.english: 102:17 But the mercy of the Lord is from eternity * and unto eternity upon them that fear him:

segments.t: Misericórdia autem Dómini ab ætérno, * et usque in ætérnum super timéntes eum.

content.latin: 102:17 Et iustítia illíus in fílios filiórum, * his qui servant testaméntum eius:
content.english: 102:17 And his justice unto children’s children, * to such as keep his covenant,

segments.t: Et iustítia illíus in fílios filiórum, * his qui servant testaméntum eius:

content.latin: 102:18 Et mémores sunt mandatórum ipsíus, * ad faciéndum ea.
content.english: 102:18 And are mindful of his commandments * to do them.

segments.t: Et mémores sunt mandatórum ipsíus, * ad faciéndum ea.

content.latin: 102:19 Dóminus in cælo parávit sedem suam: * et regnum ipsíus ómnibus dominábitur.
content.english: 102:19 The Lord hath prepared his throne in heaven: * and his kingdom shall rule over all.

segments.t: Dóminus in cælo parávit sedem suam: * et regnum ipsíus ómnibus dominábitur.

content.latin: 102:20 Benedícite Dómino, omnes Ángeli eius: * poténtes virtúte, faciéntes verbum illíus, ad audiéndam vocem sermónum eius.
content.english: 102:20 Bless the Lord, all ye his angels: * you that are mighty in strength, and execute his word, hearkening to the voice of his orders.

segments.t: Benedícite Dómino, omnes Ángeli eius: * poténtes virtúte, faciéntes verbum illíus, ad audiéndam vocem sermónum eius.

content.latin: 102:21 Benedícite Dómino, omnes virtútes eius: * minístri eius, qui fácitis voluntátem eius.
content.english: 102:21 Bless the Lord, all ye his hosts: * you ministers of his that do his will.

segments.t: Benedícite Dómino, omnes virtútes eius: * minístri eius, qui fácitis voluntátem eius.

content.latin: 102:22 Benedícite Dómino, ómnia ópera eius: * in omni loco dominatiónis eius, bénedic, ánima mea, Dómino.
content.english: 102:22 Bless the Lord, all his works: * in every place of his dominion, O my soul, bless thou the Lord.

segments.t: Benedícite Dómino, ómnia ópera eius: * in omni loco dominatiónis eius, bénedic, ánima mea, Dómino.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Benedícite Dómino, omnes Angeli eius, poténtes virtúte, faciéntes verbum illíus, ad audiéndam vocem sermónum eius.
content.english: Ant. Bless the Lord, all ye His Angels, that excel in strength, that do His commandments, to hearken unto the voice of His word.

segments.t: Ant.
Benedícite Dómino, omnes Angeli eius, poténtes virtúte, faciéntes verbum illíus, ad audiéndam vocem sermónum eius.

content.latin: ℣. In conspéctu Angelórum psallam tibi, Deus meus.
content.english: ℣. Before the Angels will I sing praise unto thee, O my God.

segments.t: In conspéctu Angelórum psallam tibi, Deus meus.

content.latin: ℟. Adorábo ad templum sanctum tuum, et confitébor nómini tuo.
content.english: ℟. I will worship toward thy holy Temple, and praise thy Name.

segments.t: Adorábo ad templum sanctum tuum, et confitébor nómini tuo.

content.latin: Pater Noster dicitur secreto usque ad Et ne nos indúcas in tentatiónem:
content.english: Our Father is said silently until And lead us not into temptation:.

segments.t: Pater Noster dicitur secreto usque ad Et ne nos indúcas in tentatiónem:

content.latin: Pater noster, qui es in cælis, sanctificétur nomen tuum: advéniat regnum tuum: fiat volúntas tua, sicut in cælo et in terra. Panem nostrum cotidiánum da nobis hódie: et dimítte nobis débita nostra, sicut et nos dimíttimus debitóribus nostris:
content.english: Our Father, who art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done on earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread. And forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us.

content.latin: ℣. Et ne nos indúcas in tentatiónem:
content.english: ℣. And lead us not into temptation:

segments.t: Et ne nos indúcas in tentatiónem:

content.latin: ℟. Sed líbera nos a malo.
content.english: ℟. But deliver us from evil.

segments.t: Sed líbera nos a malo.

content.latin: Absolutio. Ipsíus píetas et misericórdia nos ádiuvet, qui cum Patre et Spíritu Sancto vivit et regnat in sǽcula sæculórum.
content.english: Absolution. May His loving-kindness and mercy help us, Who liveth and reigneth with the Father, and the Holy Ghost, world without end.

segments.t: Absolutio.
Ipsíus píetas et misericórdia nos ádiuvet, qui cum Patre et Spíritu Sancto vivit et regnat in sǽcula sæculórum.

content.latin: ℟. Amen.
content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.

content.latin: ℣. Iube, Dómine, benedícere.
content.english: ℣. Grant, Lord, a blessing.

segments.t: Iube, Dómine, benedícere.

content.latin: Benedictio. Ille nos benedícat, qui sine fine vivit et regnat.
content.english: Benediction. May His blessing be upon us who doth live and reign for ever.

segments.t: Benedictio.
Ille nos benedícat, qui sine fine vivit et regnat.

content.latin: ℟. Amen.
content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.

content.latin: De libro Exodi
content.english: From the Book of Exodus

content.latin: 20 Ecce ego mittam Angelum meum, qui præcédat te et custódiat in via et introdúcat in locum quem parávi.
content.english: 20 Behold I will send my angel, who shall go before thee, and keep thee in thy journey, and bring thee into the place that I have prepared.

segments.t: Ecce ego mittam Angelum meum, qui præcédat te et custódiat in via et introdúcat in locum quem parávi.

content.latin: 21 Obsérva eum et audi vocem eius, nec contemnéndum putes, quia non dimíttet, cum peccáveris, et est nomen meum in illo.
content.english: 21 Take notice of him, and hear his voice, and do not think him one to be contemned: for he will not forgive when thou hast sinned, and my name is in him.

segments.t: Obsérva eum et audi vocem eius, nec contemnéndum putes, quia non dimíttet, cum peccáveris, et est nomen meum in illo.

content.latin: 22 Quod, si audíeris vocem eius et féceris ómnia quæ loquor, inimícus ero inimícis tuis et afflígam affligéntes te.
content.english: 22 But if thou wilt hear his voice, and do all that I speak, I will be an enemy to thy enemies, and will afflict them that afflict thee.

segments.t: Quod, si audíeris vocem eius et féceris ómnia quæ loquor, inimícus ero inimícis tuis et afflígam affligéntes te.

content.latin: 23 Præcedétque te Angelus meus.
content.english: 23 And my angel shall go before thee, and shall bring thee in unto the Amorrhite, and the Hethite, and the Pherezite, and the Chanaanite, and the Hevite, and the Jebusite, whom I will destroy.

segments.t: Præcedétque te Angelus meus.

content.latin: ℣. Tu autem, Dómine, miserére nobis.
content.english: ℣. But thou, O Lord, have mercy upon us.

segments.t: Tu autem, Dómine, miserére nobis.

content.latin: ℟. Deo grátias.
content.english: ℟. Thanks be to God.

segments.t: Deo grátias.

content.latin: ℟. Angelis suis Deus mandávit de te, ut custódiant te in ómnibus viis tuis:
content.english: ℟. God hath given His Angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.

segments.t: Angelis suis Deus mandávit de te, ut custódiant te in ómnibus viis tuis:

content.latin: * In mánibus portábunt te, ne umquam offéndas ad lápidem pedem tuum.
content.english: * They shall bear thee up in their hands, lest haply thou dash thy foot against a stone.

content.latin: ℣. Míllia míllium ministrábant ei, et décies míllies centéna míllia assistébant ei.
content.english: ℣. Thousands of thousands ministered unto Him, and ten thousand times hundreds of thousands stood before Him.

segments.t: Míllia míllium ministrábant ei, et décies míllies centéna míllia assistébant ei.

content.latin: ℟. In mánibus portábunt te, ne umquam offéndas ad lápidem pedem tuum.
content.english: ℟. They shall bear thee up in their hands, lest haply thou dash thy foot against a stone.

segments.t: In mánibus portábunt te, ne umquam offéndas ad lápidem pedem tuum.

content.latin: ℣. Iube, Dómine, benedícere.
content.english: ℣. Grant, Lord, a blessing.

segments.t: Iube, Dómine, benedícere.

content.latin: Benedictio. Quorum festum cólimus, ipsi intercédant pro nobis ad Dóminum.
content.english: Benediction. They whose feast-day we are keeping, be our Advocates with God.

segments.t: Benedictio.
Quorum festum cólimus, ipsi intercédant pro nobis ad Dóminum.

content.latin: ℟. Amen.
content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.

content.latin: De Zacharía Prophéta
content.english: From Zacharias the Prophet

content.latin: Zach 1:7-11
content.english: Zech 1:7-11

segments.t: Zach 1:7-11

content.latin: 7 Factum est verbum Dómini ad Zacharíam, fílium Barachíæ fílii Addo, prophétam, dicens:
content.english: 7 In the four and twentieth day of the eleventh month which is called Sabath, in the second year of Darius, the word of the Lord came to Zacharias the son of Barachias, the son of Addo, the prophet, saying:

segments.t: Factum est verbum Dómini ad Zacharíam, fílium Barachíæ fílii Addo, prophétam, dicens:

content.latin: 8 Vidi per noctem, et ecce Vir ascéndens super equum rufum, et ipse stabat inter myrtéta, quæ erant in profúndo, et post eum equi rufi, várii et albi,
content.english: 8 I saw by night, and behold a man riding upon a red horse, and he stood among the myrtle trees, that were in the bottom: and behind him were horses, red, speckled, and white.

segments.t: Vidi per noctem, et ecce Vir ascéndens super equum rufum, et ipse stabat inter myrtéta, quæ erant in profúndo, et post eum equi rufi, várii et albi,

content.latin: 9 Et dixi: Quid sunt isti, Dómine mi? Et dixit ad me Angelus qui loquebátur in me; Ego osténdam tibi quid sint hæc.
content.english: 9 And I said: What are these, my Lord? and the angel that spoke in me, said to me: I will shew thee what these are:

segments.t: Et dixi: Quid sunt isti, Dómine mi? Et dixit ad me Angelus qui loquebátur in me; Ego osténdam tibi quid sint hæc.

content.latin: 10 Et respóndit vir qui stabat inter myrtéta et dixit: Isti sunt quos misit Dóminus ut perámbulent terram.
content.english: 10 And the man that stood among the myrtle trees answered, and said: These are they, whom the Lord hath sent to walk through the earth.

segments.t: Et respóndit vir qui stabat inter myrtéta et dixit: Isti sunt quos misit Dóminus ut perámbulent terram.

content.latin: 11 Et respondérunt Angelo Dómini, qui stabat inter myrtéta, et dixérunt: Perambulávimus terram, et ecce omnis terra habitátur et quiéscit.
content.english: 11 And they answered the angel of the Lord, that stood among the myrtle trees, and said: We have walked through the earth, and behold all the earth is inhabited, and is at rest.

segments.t: Et respondérunt Angelo Dómini, qui stabat inter myrtéta, et dixérunt: Perambulávimus terram, et ecce omnis terra habitátur et quiéscit.

content.latin: Zach 2:1-5
content.english: Zech 2:1-5

segments.t: Zach 2:1-5

content.latin: 1 Et levávi óculos meos et vidi, et ecce vir, et in manu eius funículus mensórum;
content.english: 1 And I lifted up my eyes, and saw, and behold a man, with a measuring line in his hand.

segments.t: Et levávi óculos meos et vidi, et ecce vir, et in manu eius funículus mensórum;

content.latin: 2 Et dixi: Quo tu vadis? Et dixit ad me: Ut métiar Ierúsalem et vídeam quanta sit latitúdo eius, et quanta longitúdo eius.
content.english: 2 And I said: Whither goest thou? and he said to me: To measure Jerusalem, and to see how great is the breadth thereof, and how great the length thereof.

segments.t: Et dixi: Quo tu vadis? Et dixit ad me: Ut métiar Ierúsalem et vídeam quanta sit latitúdo eius, et quanta longitúdo eius.

segments.t: In Psalmum Qui habitat

content.latin: Angelis suis mandávit de te. Mira dignátio, et vere magna diléctio caritátis. Quis enim? quibus? de quo? quid mandávit? Studióse considerémus, fratres, diligénter commendémus memóriæ hoc tam grande mandátum. Quis enim mandávit? cuius sunt Angeli? cuius mandátis obtémperant? cuius obédiunt voluntáti? Nempe Angelis suis mandávit de te, ut custódiant te in ómnibus viis tuis. Nec cunctántur quin étiam in mánibus tollant te. Summa ergo Maiéstas mandávit Angelis, et Angelis suis mandávit. Illis útique sublímibus, tam beátis quam próximis sibi cohæréntibus et vere domésticis mandávit de te. Tu quis es? Quid est homo, quod memor es eius? aut fílius hóminis, quóniam réputas eum? Quasi vero non sit homo putrédo, et fílius hóminis vermis! Sed quid putas mandávit de te? Ut custódiant te.
content.english: He hath given His Angels charge over thee. A wonderful graciousness, and a wonderful outpouring of love. For who hath given charge? And what charge? Unto whom? And over whom? Let us carefully consider, my brethren, let us carefully hold in mind this great charge. For who hath given this charge? To Whom belong the Angels? Whose commandments do they obey, and Whose will do they do? He hath given His Angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways, and that not carelessly, for they shall bear thee up in their hands. The Highest Majesty, therefore, hath given charge unto Angels, even His Angels. Unto these beings so excellently exalted, so blessed, so near to Himself, even as His own household, unto these hath He given charge over thee. Who art thou? What is man, that Thou art mindful of him? or the son of man, that Thou visitest him? Ps. viii. 5. Even as though man were not rottenness, and the son of man, a worm. Job. xxv. 6. But what charge hath He given them over thee? To keep thee in all thy ways.

segments.t: Benedícite, aquæ omnes, quæ super cælos sunt, Dómino: * benedícite, omnes virtútes Dómini, Dómino.

segments.t: Benedícite, sol et luna, Dómino: * benedícite, stellæ cæli, Dómino.

segments.t: Benedícat terra Dóminum: * laudet et superexáltet eum in sǽcula.

segments.t: Benedícite, fontes, Dómino: * benedícite, mária et flúmina, Dómino.

content.english: 3:69 O ye whales, and all that move in the waters, bless the Lord: * O all ye fowls of the air, bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedícite, cete, et ómnia, quæ movéntur in aquis, Dómino: * benedícite, omnes vólucres cæli, Dómino.

content.english: 3:70 O all ye beasts and cattle, bless the Lord: * O ye sons of men, bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedícite, omnes béstiæ et pécora, Dómino: * benedícite, fílii hóminum, Dómino.

content.english: 3:71 O let Israel bless the Lord: * let them praise and exalt him above all for ever.

segments.t: Benedícat Israël Dóminum: * laudet et superexáltet eum in sǽcula.

content.latin: 3:72 Benedícite, sacerdótes Dómini, Dómino: * benedícite, servi Dómini, Dómino.
content.english: 3:72 O ye priests of the Lord, bless the Lord: * O ye servants of the Lord, bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedícite, sacerdótes Dómini, Dómino: * benedícite, servi Dómini, Dómino.

content.english: 3:73 O ye spirits and souls of the just, bless the Lord: * O ye holy and humble of heart, bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedícite, spíritus, et ánimæ iustórum, Dómino: * benedícite, sancti, et húmiles corde, Dómino.

content.english: 3:74 O Ananias, Azarias, and Misael, bless ye the Lord: * praise and exalt him above all for ever.

segments.t: Benedícite, Ananía, Azaría, Mísaël, Dómino: * laudáte et superexaltáte eum in sǽcula.

content.latin: 148:1 Laudáte Dóminum de cælis: * laudáte eum in excélsis.
content.english: 148:1 Praise ye the Lord from the heavens * praise ye him in the high places.

segments.t: Laudáte Dóminum de cælis: * laudáte eum in excélsis.

content.latin: 148:2 Laudáte eum, omnes Ángeli eius: * laudáte eum, omnes virtútes eius.
content.english: 148:2 Praise ye him, all his angels: * praise ye him, all his hosts.

segments.t: Laudáte eum, omnes Ángeli eius: * laudáte eum, omnes virtútes eius.

content.latin: 148:3 Laudáte eum, sol et luna: * laudáte eum, omnes stellæ et lumen.
content.english: 148:3 Praise ye him, O sun and moon: * praise him, all ye stars and light.

segments.t: Laudáte eum, sol et luna: * laudáte eum, omnes stellæ et lumen.

content.latin: 148:4 Laudáte eum, cæli cælórum: * et aquæ omnes, quæ super cælos sunt, laudent nomen Dómini.
content.english: 148:4 Praise him, ye heavens of heavens: * and let all the waters that are above the heavens, praise the name of the Lord.

segments.t: Laudáte eum, cæli cælórum: * et aquæ omnes, quæ super cælos sunt, laudent nomen Dómini.

content.latin: 148:5 Quia ipse dixit, et facta sunt: * ipse mandávit, et creáta sunt.
content.english: 148:5 For he spoke, and they were made: * he commanded, and they were created.

segments.t: Quia ipse dixit, et facta sunt: * ipse mandávit, et creáta sunt.

content.latin: 148:6 Státuit ea in ætérnum, et in sǽculum sǽculi: * præcéptum pósuit, et non præteríbit.
content.english: 148:6 He hath established them for ever, and for ages of ages: * he hath made a decree, and it shall not pass away.

segments.t: Státuit ea in ætérnum, et in sǽculum sǽculi: * præcéptum pósuit, et non præteríbit.

content.latin: 148:7 Laudáte Dóminum de terra, * dracónes, et omnes abýssi.
content.english: 148:7 Praise the Lord from the earth, * ye dragons, and all ye deeps:

segments.t: Laudáte Dóminum de terra, * dracónes, et omnes abýssi.

content.latin: 148:8 Ignis, grando, nix, glácies, spíritus procellárum: * quæ fáciunt verbum eius:
content.english: 148:8 Fire, hail, snow, ice, stormy winds * which fulfill his word:

segments.t: Ignis, grando, nix, glácies, spíritus procellárum: * quæ fáciunt verbum eius:

content.latin: 148:9 Montes, et omnes colles: * ligna fructífera, et omnes cedri.
content.english: 148:9 Mountains and all hills, * fruitful trees and all cedars:

segments.t: Montes, et omnes colles: * ligna fructífera, et omnes cedri.

content.latin: 148:10 Béstiæ, et univérsa pécora: * serpéntes, et vólucres pennátæ:
content.english: 148:10 Beasts and all cattle: * serpents and feathered fowls:

segments.t: Béstiæ, et univérsa pécora: * serpéntes, et vólucres pennátæ:

segments.t: Reges terræ, et omnes pópuli: * príncipes, et omnes iúdices terræ.

content.english: 148:12 Young men and maidens: let the old with the younger, praise the name of the Lord: * For his name alone is exalted.

segments.t: Iúvenes, et vírgines: senes cum iunióribus laudent nomen Dómini: * quia exaltátum est nomen eius solíus.

content.latin: 148:14 Conféssio eius super cælum et terram: * et exaltávit cornu pópuli sui.
content.english: 148:14 The praise of him is above heaven and earth: * and he hath exalted the horn of his people.

segments.t: Conféssio eius super cælum et terram: * et exaltávit cornu pópuli sui.

content.english: 148:14 A hymn to all his saints: to the children of Israel, a people approaching him.

segments.t: Hymnus ómnibus sanctis eius: * fíliis Israël, pópulo appropinquánti sibi.

content.english: Behold I will send my angel, who shall go before thee, and keep thee in thy journey, and bring thee into the place that I have prepared. Take notice of him, and hear his voice.

content.english: ℟. Thanks be to God.

content.latin: Hymnus
content.english: Hymn

segments.t: Hymnus

content.latin: Ætérne Rector síderum
content.english: Ruler of the dread immense!

content.latin: Qui, quidquid est, poténtia
content.english: Maker of this mighty frame!

content.latin: Magna creásti, nec regis
content.english: Whose eternal providence

content.latin: Minóre providéntia:
content.english: Guides it, as from thee it came:

content.latin: Adésto supplicántium
content.english: Low before thy throne we bend;

content.latin: Tibi reórum cœ́tui,
content.english: Hear our supplicating cries;

content.latin: Lucísque sub crepúsculum
content.english: And thy light celestial send

content.latin: Lucem novam da méntibus.
content.english: With the freshly dawning skies.

content.latin: Tuúsque nobis Angelus
content.english: King of kings, and Lord most high!

content.latin: Eléctus ad custódiam,
content.english: This of thy dear love we pray:

content.latin: Hic adsit; a contágio
content.english: May thy guardian angel nigh,

content.latin: Ut críminum nos prótegat.
content.english: Keep us from all sin this day.

content.latin: Nobis dracónis ǽmuli
content.english: May he crush the deadly wiles

content.latin: Versútias extérminet;
content.english: Of the envious serpent's art,

content.latin: Ne rete frauduléntiæ
content.english: Ever spreading cunning toils

content.latin: Incáuta nectat péctora.
content.english: Round about the thoughtless heart.

content.latin: Metum repéllat hóstium
content.english: May he scatter ruthless war

content.latin: Nostris procul de fínibus;
content.english: Ere to this our land it come;

content.latin: Pacem procúret cívium,
content.english: Plague and famine drive away,

content.latin: Fugétque pestiléntiam.
content.english: Fix securely peace at home.

content.latin: Deo Patri sit glória,
content.english: Father, Son, and Holy Ghost,

content.latin: Qui, quos redémit Fílius
content.english: One eternal Trinity!

content.latin: Et Sanctus unxit Spíritus,
content.english: Guard by thy angelic host

content.latin: Per Angelos custódiant.
content.english: Us who put our trust in thee.

content.latin: Amen.
content.english: Amen.

content.latin: ℣. In conspéctu Angelórum psallam tibi, Deus meus.
content.english: ℣. Before the Angels will I sing praise unto thee, O my God.

segments.t: In conspéctu Angelórum psallam tibi, Deus meus.

content.latin: 1:68 Benedíctus ✠ Dóminus, Deus Israël: * quia visitávit, et fecit redemptiónem plebis suæ:
content.english: 1:68 Blessed be the Lord ✠ God of Israel; * because he hath visited and wrought the redemption of his people:

segments.t: Benedíctus ✠ Dóminus, Deus Israël: * quia visitávit, et fecit redemptiónem plebis suæ:

content.latin: 1:69 Et eréxit cornu salútis nobis: * in domo David, púeri sui.
content.english: 1:69 And hath raised up an horn of salvation to us, * in the house of David his servant:

segments.t: Et eréxit cornu salútis nobis: * in domo David, púeri sui.

content.latin: 1:70 Sicut locútus est per os sanctórum, * qui a sǽculo sunt, prophetárum eius:
content.english: 1:70 As he spoke by the mouth of his holy Prophets, * who are from the beginning:

segments.t: Sicut locútus est per os sanctórum, * qui a sǽculo sunt, prophetárum eius:

content.latin: 1:71 Salútem ex inimícis nostris, * et de manu ómnium, qui odérunt nos.
content.english: 1:71 Salvation from our enemies, * and from the hand of all that hate us:

segments.t: Salútem ex inimícis nostris, * et de manu ómnium, qui odérunt nos.

content.latin: 1:72 Ad faciéndam misericórdiam cum pátribus nostris: * et memorári testaménti sui sancti.
content.english: 1:72 To perform mercy to our fathers, * and to remember his holy testament,

segments.t: Ad faciéndam misericórdiam cum pátribus nostris: * et memorári testaménti sui sancti.

content.latin: 1:73 Iusiurándum, quod iurávit ad Ábraham patrem nostrum, * datúrum se nobis:
content.english: 1:73 The oath, which he swore to Abraham our father, * that he would grant to us,

segments.t: Iusiurándum, quod iurávit ad Ábraham patrem nostrum, * datúrum se nobis:

content.latin: 1:74 Ut sine timóre, de manu inimicórum nostrórum liberáti, * serviámus illi.
content.english: 1:74 That being delivered from the hand of our enemies, * we may serve him without fear,

segments.t: Ut sine timóre, de manu inimicórum nostrórum liberáti, * serviámus illi.

content.latin: 1:75 In sanctitáte, et iustítia coram ipso, * ómnibus diébus nostris.
content.english: 1:75 In holiness and justice before him, * all our days.

segments.t: In sanctitáte, et iustítia coram ipso, * ómnibus diébus nostris.

content.latin: 1:76 Et tu, puer, Prophéta Altíssimi vocáberis: * præíbis enim ante fáciem Dómini, paráre vias eius:
content.english: 1:76 And thou, child, shalt be called the prophet of the Highest: * for thou shalt go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways:

segments.t: Et tu, puer, Prophéta Altíssimi vocáberis: * præíbis enim ante fáciem Dómini, paráre vias eius:

content.latin: 1:77 Ad dandam sciéntiam salútis plebi eius: * in remissiónem peccatórum eórum:
content.english: 1:77 To give knowledge of salvation to his people, * unto the remission of their sins:

segments.t: Ad dandam sciéntiam salútis plebi eius: * in remissiónem peccatórum eórum:

content.latin: 1:78 Per víscera misericórdiæ Dei nostri: * in quibus visitávit nos, óriens ex alto:

content.latin: Deus, qui ineffábili providéntia sanctos Angelos tuos ad nostram custódiam míttere dignáris: largíre supplícibus tuis; et eórum semper protectióne deféndi, et ætérna societáte gaudére.
content.english: O God, Who in thine unspeakable Providence hast been pleased to give thine holy Angels charge over us, to keep us, mercifully grant unto our prayers, that we be both ever fenced by their wardship here, and everlastingly blessed by their fellowship hereafter.

content.latin: Iam lucis orto sídere,
content.english: Now in the sun's new dawning ray,

content.english: Lowly of heart, our God we pray

content.english: That he from harm may keep us free

content.english: In all the deeds this day shall see.

content.latin: Linguam refrénans témperet,
content.english: May fear of him our tongues restrain,

content.latin: Ne litis horror ínsonet:
content.english: Lest strife unguarded speech should stain:

content.latin: Visum fovéndo cóntegat,
content.english: His favouring care our guardian be,

content.latin: Ne vanitátes háuriat.
content.english: Lest our eyes feed on vanity.

content.latin: Sint pura cordis íntima,
content.english: May every heart be pure from sin

content.latin: Absístat et vecórdia;
content.english: And folly find no place therein:

content.latin: Carnis terat supérbiam
content.english: Scant need of food, excess denied,

content.latin: Potus cibíque párcitas.
content.english: Wear down in us the body's pride.

content.latin: Ut, cum dies abscésserit,
content.english: That when the light of day is gone,

content.latin: Noctémque sors redúxerit,
content.english: And night in course shall follow on.

content.latin: Mundi per abstinéntiam
content.english: We, free from cares the world affords,

content.english: May chant the praise that is our Lord's.

content.latin: Deo Patri sit glória,
content.english: All laud to God the Father be,

content.english: All praise, Eternal Son, to thee:

content.english: All glory, as is ever meet,

content.latin: 21:2 Deus, Deus meus, réspice in me: quare me dereliquísti? * longe a salúte mea verba delictórum meórum.
content.english: 21:2 O God my God, look upon me: why hast thou forsaken me? * Far from my salvation are the words of my sins.

segments.t: Deus, Deus meus, réspice in me: quare me dereliquísti? * longe a salúte mea verba delictórum meórum.

content.latin: 21:3 Deus meus, clamábo per diem, et non exáudies: * et nocte, et non ad insipiéntiam mihi.
content.english: 21:3 O my God, I shall cry by day, and thou wilt not hear: * and by night, and it shall not be reputed as folly in me.

segments.t: Deus meus, clamábo per diem, et non exáudies: * et nocte, et non ad insipiéntiam mihi.

content.latin: 21:4 Tu autem in sancto hábitas, * laus Israël.
content.english: 21:4 But thou dwellest in the holy place, * the praise of Israel.

segments.t: Tu autem in sancto hábitas, * laus Israël.

content.latin: 21:5 In te speravérunt patres nostri: * speravérunt, et liberásti eos.
content.english: 21:5 In thee have our fathers hoped: * they have hoped, and thou hast delivered them.

segments.t: In te speravérunt patres nostri: * speravérunt, et liberásti eos.

content.latin: 21:6 Ad te clamavérunt, et salvi facti sunt: * in te speravérunt, et non sunt confúsi.
content.english: 21:6 They cried to thee, and they were saved: * they trusted in thee, and were not confounded.

segments.t: Ad te clamavérunt, et salvi facti sunt: * in te speravérunt, et non sunt confúsi.

content.latin: 21:7 Ego autem sum vermis, et non homo: * oppróbrium hóminum, et abiéctio plebis.
content.english: 21:7 But I am a worm, and no man: * the reproach of men, and the outcast of the people.

segments.t: Ego autem sum vermis, et non homo: * oppróbrium hóminum, et abiéctio plebis.

content.latin: 21:8 Omnes vidéntes me, derisérunt me: * locúti sunt lábiis, et movérunt caput.
content.english: 21:8 All they that saw me have laughed me to scorn: * they have spoken with the lips, and wagged the head.

segments.t: Omnes vidéntes me, derisérunt me: * locúti sunt lábiis, et movérunt caput.

content.latin: 21:9 Sperávit in Dómino, erípiat eum: * salvum fáciat eum, quóniam vult eum.
content.english: 21:9 He hoped in the Lord, let him deliver him: * let him save him, seeing he delighteth in him.

segments.t: Sperávit in Dómino, erípiat eum: * salvum fáciat eum, quóniam vult eum.

content.latin: 21:10 Quóniam tu es, qui extraxísti me de ventre: * spes mea ab ubéribus matris meæ. In te proiéctus sum ex útero:
content.english: 21:10 For thou art he that hast drawn me out of the womb: * my hope from the breasts of my mother. I was cast upon thee from the womb.

segments.t: Quóniam tu es, qui extraxísti me de ventre: * spes mea ab ubéribus matris meæ. In te proiéctus sum ex útero:

content.latin: 21:11 De ventre matris meæ Deus meus es tu, * ne discésseris a me:
content.english: 21:11 From my mother’s womb thou art my God, * depart not from me.

segments.t: De ventre matris meæ Deus meus es tu, * ne discésseris a me:

content.latin: 21:12 Quóniam tribulátio próxima est: * quóniam non est qui ádiuvet.
content.english: 21:12 For tribulation is very near: * for there is none to help me.

segments.t: Quóniam tribulátio próxima est: * quóniam non est qui ádiuvet.

content.latin: 21:13 Circumdedérunt me vítuli multi: * tauri pingues obsedérunt me.
content.english: 21:13 Many calves have surrounded me: * fat bulls have besieged me.

segments.t: Circumdedérunt me vítuli multi: * tauri pingues obsedérunt me.

content.latin: 21:14 Aperuérunt super me os suum, * sicut leo rápiens et rúgiens.
content.english: 21:14 They have opened their mouths against me, * as a lion ravening and roaring.

segments.t: Aperuérunt super me os suum, * sicut leo rápiens et rúgiens.

content.latin: 21:15 Sicut aqua effúsus sum: * et dispérsa sunt ómnia ossa mea.
content.english: 21:15 I am poured out like water; * and all my bones are scattered.

segments.t: Sicut aqua effúsus sum: * et dispérsa sunt ómnia ossa mea.

content.latin: 21:15 Factum est cor meum tamquam cera liquéscens * in médio ventris mei.
content.english: 21:15 My heart is become like wax melting * in the midst of my bowels.

segments.t: Factum est cor meum tamquam cera liquéscens * in médio ventris mei.

content.latin: 21:16 Áruit tamquam testa virtus mea, et lingua mea adhǽsit fáucibus meis: * et in púlverem mortis deduxísti me.
content.english: 21:16 My strength is dried up like a potsherd, and my tongue hath cleaved to my jaws: * and thou hast brought me down into the dust of death.

segments.t: Áruit tamquam testa virtus mea, et lingua mea adhǽsit fáucibus meis: * et in púlverem mortis deduxísti me.

content.latin: 21:17 Quóniam circumdedérunt me canes multi: * concílium malignántium obsédit me.
content.english: 21:17 For many dogs have encompassed me: * the council of the malignant hath besieged me.

segments.t: Quóniam circumdedérunt me canes multi: * concílium malignántium obsédit me.

content.latin: 21:17 Fodérunt manus meas et pedes meos: * dinumeravérunt ómnia ossa mea.
content.english: 21:17 They have dug my hands and feet. * They have numbered all my bones.

segments.t: Fodérunt manus meas et pedes meos: * dinumeravérunt ómnia ossa mea.

content.latin: 21:18 Ipsi vero consideravérunt et inspexérunt me: * divisérunt sibi vestiménta mea, et super vestem meam misérunt sortem.
content.english: 21:18 And they have looked and stared upon me. * They parted my garments amongst them; and upon my vesture they cast lots.

segments.t: Ipsi vero consideravérunt et inspexérunt me: * divisérunt sibi vestiménta mea, et super vestem meam misérunt sortem.

content.latin: 21:20 Tu autem, Dómine, ne elongáveris auxílium tuum a me: * ad defensiónem meam cónspice.
content.english: 21:20 But thou, O Lord, remove not thy help to a distance from me; * look towards my defence.

segments.t: Tu autem, Dómine, ne elongáveris auxílium tuum a me: * ad defensiónem meam cónspice.

content.latin: 21:21 Érue a frámea, Deus, ánimam meam: * et de manu canis únicam meam:
content.english: 21:21 Deliver, O God, my soul from the sword: * my only one from the hand of the dog.

segments.t: Érue a frámea, Deus, ánimam meam: * et de manu canis únicam meam:

content.latin: 21:22 Salva me ex ore leónis: * et a córnibus unicórnium humilitátem meam.
content.english: 21:22 Save me from the lion’s mouth; * and my lowness from the horns of the unicorns.

segments.t: Salva me ex ore leónis: * et a córnibus unicórnium humilitátem meam.

content.latin: 21:23 Narrábo nomen tuum frátribus meis: * in médio ecclésiæ laudábo te.
content.english: 21:23 I will declare thy name to my brethren: * in the midst of the church will I praise thee.

segments.t: Narrábo nomen tuum frátribus meis: * in médio ecclésiæ laudábo te.
